decision.title: WebAssembly toolchain
decision.summary: The WebAssembly build uses WASI SDK to produce a standalone module wrapped by a small hand-written TypeScript package, without Emscripten's JavaScript system emulation.

body.p: WASI SDK producing a standalone module, wrapped by a small hand-written TypeScript package. The core does no I/O of its own, so Emscripten's JavaScript system emulation is not needed. Confirmed at the Phase 0 gate: the wasm preset builds with WASI SDK 34 and runs the tests under Node.js (, ). The TypeScript package arrives with the first public API (Phase 1 onwards).
